title: Design: Close window without an accounting integration has no account notes
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a customer flagged as Internal customer, with one asset, and its default internal category left at General Internal.
  • Use a location with no QuickBooks and no AccountingHub.
  • Have a new internal work order for that customer with every line Complete, made for this test.
  • Open the attached picture iwo-flow1-18-7c-close-no-accounting-integration.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open the internal work order.
  2. Click Close Work Order.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The work order opens.

Step 2:

  • The rows show no account notes.
  • The sentence under them reads "This marks the work order Closed · Internal. Parts cost, shop supplies and hours are available in the Internal Work Orders report."

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11760 (Story 3, Close an internal or no-charge work order)

  • S3-E4: “If the shop has no accounting integration at the work order's location, Close shows the confirmation without account notes, and the sentence of S3-R2 is replaced by "This marks the work order Closed · Internal (Closed · No Charge). Parts cost, shop supplies and hours are available in the Internal Work Orders report." (with "This completes the work order and marks it ..." when it is not yet Complete)”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
